children: SINGAPUR (dpa-AFX) - Wednesday, Wilmar International Limited (WLMIY.PK) announced its financial results for the third quarter, reporting a net profit of $281.03 million compared with a net loss of $347.7 million in the prior year.
EBITDA totaled $981.99 million compared with $426.02 million in the previous year.
Revenue rose 13.6 percent, to $21.661 billion from last year's $19.065 billion.
Wilmar's stock closed trading at $25.32, down 2.24 percent on the OTC Markets.
